events.title: Demo Update | Steam Achievements Are Here!
events.summary: Demo Update | Steam Achievements Are Here! Steam Achievements have officially been added to the Last Offer: Car Dealer Demo! You can now unlock achievements as you play, complete objectives, and progress through your car dealership journey. This update also includes minor bug fixes and improvements to the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for playing and supporting Last Offer: Car Dealer! Don't forget to wishlist the full game!

events.title: Demo Update | October 8, 2026
events.summary: Demo Update | October 8, 2026 We've released a new update for the Last Offer: Car Dealer Demo! This update focuses on improving vehicle handling, customization, trading, and overall gameplay. We've also fixed several issues reported by players. Vehicle Customization & SuspensionImproved suspension physics. Lowered cars can now drive over curbs, small bumps, and showroom entrances more easily.
